title: Józef Chełmoński, The four-in-hand, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Hooves pounding, mud churning under the wheels, muscles taut, and a force you feel more than you see. Chełmoński didn’t just paint a scene — he painted motion. “The Four-in-Hand” is not merely a carriage — it’s rhythm, power, and untamed energy captured in a single frame. The silver coin bearing this motif perfectly conveys that vigorous struggle with the element.
